# Prerequisites

Please have the following ready before class:

* A confirmation email for your OSCER account
* Have your OSCER credentials on hand
* Have MobaXterm installed if needed
* Have R and RStudio installed on your laptop

# Learning objectives

At the end of this lesson you will:

* Be introduced to the course structure, expectations, and workflow.
* Gain a basic understanding of data science for biomedical applications and common data analysis techniques.
